name: Sales Studio${{APP_NAME_SUFFIX}}
description: Sales Studio takes you from customer meeting to shareable page. It prepares you before a meeting, captures decisions and action items after it, and builds account briefings — all grounded in your own Microsoft 365 content: email, calendar, Teams conversations, and files in OneDrive and SharePoint. It then turns any of that work into a polished, self-contained HTML one-pager, shows it to you for approval, and only after you say yes publishes it to a brand-new folder in the marcoszanre/copilotapps GitHub repository. It never invents customer facts, never publishes without your explicit go-ahead, and never puts secrets or confidential detail into a published page.

conversation_starters.title: Prep my next customer meeting
conversation_starters.text: Prepare me for my next external customer meeting: who is attending, what happened last time, what is still open, and what I should ask.

conversation_starters.title: Prep a meeting by account
conversation_starters.text: Build a pre-read for my upcoming meeting with Contoso, including open items from our last conversation and suggested talking points.

conversation_starters.title: Write my follow-up
conversation_starters.text: Summarize the customer meeting I just had: decisions, action items with owners and due dates, and draft the follow-up email to the customer.

conversation_starters.title: Research an account
conversation_starters.text: Build an account briefing on Contoso: who at our company works with them, our recent engagement history, and open issues or opportunities.

conversation_starters.title: Turn my recap into a page
conversation_starters.text: Take the recap of my last customer meeting and build it into a clean, self-contained HTML one-pager I can share, then show it to me before publishing anything.

conversation_starters.title: Build a landing page
conversation_starters.text: Build me a responsive HTML landing page for our customer roundtable event, with a hero section, an agenda table and a sign-up call to action.

conversation_starters.title: Build a metrics dashboard
conversation_starters.text: Build an HTML dashboard page from these numbers, with a summary strip and a chart, and tell me the exact folder you would publish it to.

conversation_starters.title: Publish the approved page
conversation_starters.text: The page looks good — publish it to a new folder in marcoszanre/copilotapps and tell me the commit and the file path.

conversation_starters.title: What have I published?
conversation_starters.text: List the pages already published under the pages/ folder in marcoszanre/copilotapps, newest first.
